verdict.rationale: GitHub documents GitHub Actions as its own engine to 'automate, customize, and execute your software development workflows' in the repository, and the GitHub CLI exposes Actions from the terminal. However, no evidence explicitly shows time-based or recurring triggers (cron/schedule), so the scheduling core of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented schedule/cron triggers for workflows, recurring scheduling of Copilot agent tasks, and independent or hands-on confirmation of scheduled runs.
